title: Travel Completed | APPR | Eligible | CyberSource RED | Auto-Reject + Dispute
goal: CyberSource returns RED (high fraud risk). Case is auto-rejected. Customer is offered a dispute path where they can explain. Validates that RED triggers rejection message + dispute option, not just a dead end.

checkpoints.expected: We were unable to verify the information provided using our automated verification system due to discrepancies in the submitted details. Please note that no payment or reimbursement will be issued at this time. If you choose to dispute this automated decision, please let me know and share an explanation, and your case will be sent for further manual review. However, this process may take up to 30 business days. You'll receive an email once a decision is made. Please note that no payment or reimbursement will be issued until a decision is made. For more detail, please consult our Privacy Notice.
